verdicts.title: Error exponents of quantum state discrimination with composite correlated hypotheses

verdicts.title: On $φ$-$w$-Flat modules and Their Homological Dimensions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we introduce and study the class of $φ$-$w$-flat modules which are generalizations of both $φ$-flat modules and $w$-flat modules. The $φ$-$w$-weak global dimension $φ$-$w$-w.gl.dim$(R)$ of a strongly $φ$-ring $R$ is also introduced and studied.
